summary: Typosquat of ckcc-protocol exfiltrates installer credentials and wallet secrets at install time
details: This npm package impersonates the Coldcard ckcc-protocol library but ships an empty index.js. A postinstall script reads installer-owned secret files (~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, ~/.ssh/id_ecdsa, ~/.npmrc, ~/.gitconfig,.env*) and enumerates dotdirectories under $HOME for files matching /wallet|key|secret|seed|mnemonic|keystore|private/i or ending in.json/.pem/.key, including Solana and Ethereum keystores. The collected contents are POSTed to a hardcoded Pipedream webhook at enxhcjpo5ev.x.pipedream.net. Installing the package on a default `npm install` results in bulk exfiltration of SSH keys, cloud credentials, npm publish tokens, environment secrets, and cryptocurrency wallet material to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
